name: Remote audio (spike)
author: HamDash
description: SPIKE: the radio's receive audio in a browser on the LAN, with the numbers that say whether it is good enough

device.label: Audio input
device.help: Part of the input's name. 'mock' synthesises a test signal carrying a click on every whole second, which is what makes latency measurable without a radio. 'rig' follows the audio input set on the active radio.

rate.label: Send rate
rate.help: A receiver's audio is about 3 kHz wide, so 8-12 kHz carries all of it. 48000 is here to measure what the bandwidth actually costs.

block_ms.label: Block (ms)
block_ms.help: How much audio is in one numbered block. Smaller is lower latency and more overhead.
